jobs.name: Missed the Podium
jobs.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Asset type: ONE compact achievement emblem inside an existing badge frame, with a genuinely transparent background.
Reference image: style reference only. Match its clean ivory enamel faces, polished warm gold edges, shallow raised bevel, restrained dark edge and upper-left highlights. Bold simple silhouette, readable at 48 pixels, front-facing, centered with generous empty transparent margin on all sides. No outer badge frame, scenery, backing plate, decorative sparkles, extra icons or cast shadow outside the subject.
Subject: one large bold upright sans-serif numeral 4, with an ivory enamel face and gold bevelled outline. A confident simple fourth-place symbol. Text (verbatim): "4". No other text, ribbons, medals, laurels or decoration.

notes.podiumAwards: Champion, Silver Medalist, and Bronze Medalist use the studio's existing champion/second-place/third-place podium award artwork (output/badges/awards-kit/awards/*.png) directly, marked fullImage in concepts.json so the gallery renders them as-is instead of compositing them onto a selectable center/frame.
notes.scope: Split out of The Final Table so these three work for every tournament format, not just ones that play a Final. Rule is the player's rank in the tournament's final standings (1st/2nd/3rd) regardless of how those standings were reached. When a tournament does play a Final, its result simply decides who holds that rank — there's no separate Final-specific condition to satisfy.

rules.missed-the-podium: Final tournament standings rank === 4, whether or not a Final was played.
